en.text: In the third year of the reign of Jehoiakim king of Judah, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to Jerusalem and besieged it.

zhSimplified.text: 犹大王约雅敬在位第三年，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒来到耶路撒冷，将城围困。

zhTraditional.text: 猶大王約雅敬在位第三年，巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒來到耶路撒冷，將城圍困。

en.text: The Lord gave Jehoiakim king of Judah into his hand, with some of the vessels of the house of God; and he carried them into the land of Shinar to the house of his god. He brought the vessels into the treasure house of his god.

zhSimplified.text: 主将犹大王约雅敬，并 神殿中器皿的几分交付他手。他就把这器皿带到示拿地，收入他神的庙里，放在他神的库中。

zhTraditional.text: 主將猶大王約雅敬，並上帝殿中器皿的幾分交付他手。他就把這器皿帶到示拿地，收入他神的廟裏，放在他神的庫中。

en.text: The king spoke to Ashpenaz, the master of his eunuchs, that he should bring in some of the children of Israel, even of the royal offspring and of the nobles:

zhSimplified.text: 王吩咐太监长亚施毗拿，从以色列人的宗室和贵胄中带进几个人来，

zhTraditional.text: 王吩咐太監長亞施毗拿，從以色列人的宗室和貴冑中帶進幾個人來，

en.text: youths in whom was no defect, but well-favored, skillful in all wisdom, endowed with knowledge, understanding science, and who had the ability to stand in the king’s palace; and that he should teach them the learning and the language of the Chaldeans.

zhSimplified.text: 就是年少没有残疾、相貌俊美、通达各样学问、知识聪明俱备、足能侍立在王宫里的，要教他们迦勒底的文字言语。

zhTraditional.text: 就是年少沒有殘疾、相貌俊美、通達各樣學問、知識聰明俱備、足能侍立在王宮裏的，要教他們迦勒底的文字言語。

en.text: The king appointed for them a daily portion of the king’s delicacies and of the wine which he drank, and that they should be nourished three years, that at its end they should stand before the king.

zhSimplified.text: 王派定将自己所用的膳和所饮的酒，每日赐他们一分，养他们三年。满了三年，好叫他们在王面前侍立。

zhTraditional.text: 王派定將自己所用的膳和所飲的酒，每日賜他們一分，養他們三年。滿了三年，好叫他們在王面前侍立。

en.text: Now among these of the children of Judah were Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah.

zhSimplified.text: 他们中间有犹大族的人：但以理、哈拿尼雅、米沙利、亚撒利雅。

zhTraditional.text: 他們中間有猶大族的人：但以理、哈拿尼雅、米沙利、亞撒利雅。

en.text: The prince of the eunuchs gave names to them: to Daniel he gave the name Belteshazzar; to Hananiah, Shadrach; to Mishael, Meshach; and to Azariah, Abednego.

zhSimplified.text: 太监长给他们起名：称但以理为伯提沙撒，称哈拿尼雅为沙得拉，称米沙利为米煞，称亚撒利雅为亚伯尼歌。

zhTraditional.text: 太監長給他們起名：稱但以理為伯提沙撒，稱哈拿尼雅為沙得拉，稱米沙利為米煞，稱亞撒利雅為亞伯尼歌。

en.text: But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the king’s delicacies, nor with the wine which he drank. Therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.

zhSimplified.text: 但以理却立志不以王的膳和王所饮的酒玷污自己，所以求太监长容他不玷污自己。

zhTraditional.text: 但以理卻立志不以王的膳和王所飲的酒玷污自己，所以求太監長容他不玷污自己。

en.text: Now God made Daniel find kindness and compassion in the sight of the prince of the eunuchs.

zhSimplified.text: 神使但以理在太监长眼前蒙恩惠，受怜悯。

zhTraditional.text: 上帝使但以理在太監長眼前蒙恩惠，受憐憫。

en.text: The prince of the eunuchs said to Daniel, “I fear my lord the king, who has appointed your food and your drink. For why should he see your faces worse looking than the youths who are of your own age? Then you would endanger my head with the king.”

zhSimplified.text: 太监长对但以理说：「我惧怕我主我王，他已经派定你们的饮食，倘若他见你们的面貌比你们同岁的少年人肌瘦，怎么好呢？这样，你们就使我的头在王那里难保。」

zhTraditional.text: 太監長對但以理說：「我懼怕我主我王，他已經派定你們的飲食，倘若他見你們的面貌比你們同歲的少年人肌瘦，怎麼好呢？這樣，你們就使我的頭在王那裏難保。」

en.text: Then Daniel said to the steward whom the prince of the eunuchs had appointed over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah:

zhSimplified.text: 但以理对太监长所派管理但以理、哈拿尼雅、米沙利、亚撒利雅的委办说：

zhTraditional.text: 但以理對太監長所派管理但以理、哈拿尼雅、米沙利、亞撒利雅的委辦說：

en.text: “Test your servants, I beg you, ten days; and let them give us vegetables to eat and water to drink.

zhSimplified.text: 「求你试试仆人们十天，给我们素菜吃，白水喝，

zhTraditional.text: 「求你試試僕人們十天，給我們素菜吃，白水喝，

en.text: Then let our faces be examined before you, and the face of the youths who eat of the king’s delicacies; and as you see, deal with your servants.”

zhSimplified.text: 然后看看我们的面貌和用王膳那少年人的面貌，就照你所看的待仆人吧！」

zhTraditional.text: 然後看看我們的面貌和用王膳那少年人的面貌，就照你所看的待僕人吧！」

en.text: So he listened to them in this matter, and tested them for ten days.

zhSimplified.text: 委办便允准他们这件事，试看他们十天。

zhTraditional.text: 委辦便允准他們這件事，試看他們十天。

en.text: At the end of ten days, their faces appeared fairer and they were fatter in flesh than all the youths who ate of the king’s delicacies.

zhSimplified.text: 过了十天，见他们的面貌比用王膳的一切少年人更加俊美肥胖。

zhTraditional.text: 過了十天，見他們的面貌比用王膳的一切少年人更加俊美肥胖。

en.text: So the steward took away their delicacies and the wine that they were given to drink, and gave them vegetables.

zhSimplified.text: 于是委办撤去派他们用的膳，饮的酒，给他们素菜吃。

zhTraditional.text: 於是委辦撤去派他們用的膳，飲的酒，給他們素菜吃。

en.text: Now as for these four youths, God gave them knowledge and skill in all learning and wisdom; and Daniel had understanding in all visions and dreams.

zhSimplified.text: 这四个少年人， 神在各样文字学问上赐给他们聪明知识；但以理又明白各样的异象和梦兆。

zhTraditional.text: 這四個少年人，上帝在各樣文字學問上賜給他們聰明知識；但以理又明白各樣的異象和夢兆。

en.text: At the end of the days which the king had appointed for bringing them in, the prince of the eunuchs brought them in before Nebuchadnezzar.

zhSimplified.text: 尼布甲尼撒王预定带进少年人来的日期满了，太监长就把他们带到王面前。

zhTraditional.text: 尼布甲尼撒王預定帶進少年人來的日期滿了，太監長就把他們帶到王面前。

en.text: The king talked with them; and among them all was found no one like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah. Therefore they stood before the king.

zhSimplified.text: 王与他们谈论，见少年人中无一人能比但以理、哈拿尼雅、米沙利、亚撒利雅，所以留他们在王面前侍立。

zhTraditional.text: 王與他們談論，見少年人中無一人能比但以理、哈拿尼雅、米沙利、亞撒利雅，所以留他們在王面前侍立。

en.text: In every matter of wisdom and understanding concerning which the king inquired of them, he found them ten times better than all the magicians and enchanters who were in all his realm.

zhSimplified.text: 王考问他们一切事，就见他们的智慧聪明比通国的术士和用法术的胜过十倍。

zhTraditional.text: 王考問他們一切事，就見他們的智慧聰明比通國的術士和用法術的勝過十倍。

en.text: Daniel continued even to the first year of King Cyrus.

zhSimplified.text: 到塞鲁士王元年，但以理还在。

zhTraditional.text: 到塞魯士王元年，但以理還在。
